caption: The drawing features a large tankard with a hinged lid and a handle, depicted in shades of grey and black likely using pencil and ink wash. The cylindrical tankard is adorned with a band of decorative edging at the base and top, and the domed lid also has decorative rings and a circular relief in the center. The handle is wide and curves outward, attached to the lid with a thumb lever. Surrounding the tankard are smaller detailed sketches: an ornate band in the upper left, a segment of a decorative border with repeated geometric shapes in the upper right, a stylized face with leaves or curls around it to the right, two round coin or medallion designs with inscriptions and images below, and another simple horizontal border at the bottom left. All objects are rendered in monochrome, with shading indicating metallic surfaces and embossed decorations.
title: Pewter Tankard
